name: Brinepool Passage
desc:
Brinepool Passage leads to the [The Cold Forge](location:the_cold_forge) which has some relation to the Dormant Splinter. The walls are covered in ice and there is a blue mist circulating throughout the cave.

Ice spikes will fall from the ceiling at many parts of this location. There are many falling/disappearing platforms as you travel through this area that drop into the void. There is many not collideable ice chunks, it is advised to not trust any ground in this area.
additional_info: -   Initially, the location was called Sub-Zero Passage before being changed for unknown reason.
